batch1.description: First 50 respiratory-monitoring questions in bank order (R001–R054, with missing ID numbers). Five previously reviewed, 45 rewritten in current batch.

batch2.notes: Conservative revised explanations; image-specific items, claims about device performance or instructor preference, and clinical thresholds require individual source review.

batch3.status: Explanations rewritten, supporting source pages inspected for 41 questions, remaining passage/answer caveats flagged. Original answer keys preserved.

batch4.status: 50 explanations rewritten; each checked against supplied editions; unresolved claims explicitly flagged. No answer keys changed.

batch5.status: Reviewed temperature and vigilance records in actual JSON array order, excluding already processed questions; keys and learner state unchanged.

batch6.status: 17 vigilance and 33 breathing-circuit records in array order. Source caveats retained; no answer keys changed.

batch7.status: B038–B088 with ID gaps preserved; exact figure labels, lecture protocols and kinetics values remain flagged.

batch8.status: 50 explanations rewritten; chapter sections inspected; model-specific numerical statements and broad design claims require individual confirmation. Existing answer keys preserved.

batch9.status: N051–N102 with gaps in bank order; explanations revised; device-dependent thresholds and oversimplified clinical claims flagged; answer keys preserved.

passageVerificationReview.status: All 50 checked individually; page references denote inspected support only; unresolved keys retained and flagged.

batch10.status: 50 ventilator explanations rewritten; chapter-level references only; image panels, mode-specific statements and pediatric thresholds remain unverified.

batch11.sourceSections: Ehrenwerth 3e, Chapters 4 and 7; chapter-level association only
batch11.status: Explanations revised, exact passage/page and image-specific answer verification pending; protected fields preserved

batch12.status: 50 explanations rewritten; chapter references assigned without page-verified claims. Questionable premises and diagram-specific identifiers flagged; keys preserved.

batch13.status: 50 explanations rewritten; 11 records cite inspected printed pages for relevant principles (not necessarily full answer sets); two supplied figure families inspected; unresolved keys and numerical claims flagged.

proposedKeyCorrections.issue: 3.0 µm challenge diameter is not established as universal for filtration-efficiency testing; needs exact test method and source.
proposedKeyCorrections.proposedAction: Revise stem to identify test standard and particle diameter; rekey only after evidence.

proposedKeyCorrections.issue: Lowering fresh-gas flow increases rebreathing, but vaporizer must be turned up is not universally true; textbook Ch19 example reduces setting after low-flow transition.
proposedKeyCorrections.proposedAction: Revise question to specify uptake and concentration targets; replace universal vaporizer assertion.

proposedKeyCorrections.issue: Mainstream analyzer sensors/adapters are not universally disposable; no universally correct option appears in current choices.
proposedKeyCorrections.proposedAction: Replace keyed choice with 'Measures directly at airway without diverting gas' and then rekey.

proposedKeyCorrections.issue: Fresh-gas inflow nipple placement depends on circle-workstation design.
proposedKeyCorrections.proposedAction: Qualify to a specified conventional circuit layout.

proposedKeyCorrections.issue: Textbook describes nose, trachea and bronchi as humidifying regions, but the stem calls them upper airway; trachea may be categorized lower airway in other sources.
proposedKeyCorrections.proposedAction: Change 'upper airway' to 'conducting airway' or name textbook's definition.

progress.note: 670 complete answers have explicit structured verification; 330 remain unresolved. All 127 legacy labels individually reconciled; all 1000 explanations rewritten.

batch14.status: All 50 individually checked against inspected textbook passages. Answer keys preserved; full answer verification distinguished from partial support.

proposedKeyCorrections.issue: Phase I/anatomic dead-space gas maps to Segment 1, not keyed Segment 2. Confirm editorial intent before rekeying.

batch15.status: Every question checked against actual printed passages; eight question images visually inspected. Original keys retained. Specific caveats remain for ambiguous comparisons, unscaled figures, historical/ranking claims and serotonin-syndrome onset.

batch16.status: All50 reviewed; missing anatomical legends, ECG/key conflict, numerical values, laboratory conditions and unsupported treatment claims retained as unresolved. No page invented for unsupported items.

proposedKeyCorrections.issue: Feature3 is the T wave; no clearly numbered J wave appears.
proposedKeyCorrections.proposedAction: Replace or annotate the ECG with an actual J-wave feature, verify against textbook passage, and rekey only after review.

batch17.status: All50 reviewed against inspected passages; staged rewarming tables, fever thresholds, context-dependent mode guarantees and device-specific claims remain unresolved. Keys preserved.

batch18.status: 50 reviewed with12images; calculations recomputed; defaults, phase-specific leaks, baseline pressure and numerical reassurance remain flagged.

batch19.status: 50 reviewed with5images; pressure arithmetic and alarm principles verified; unsupported pediatric tables, mode guarantees and clinical indications remain flagged.

batch20.status: Final 50 vigilance/alarm records reviewed; four incomplete answer verifications retained.

verificationDebtReview.notes: Four previously unresolved vigilance items (V028, V029, V031, V042) now have direct Ch17 passage verification; remaining items retained. Earlier citation strings synchronized without implying verification.

rekeyed.reason: Rekeyed from option index 2 (Segment 2) to index 1 (Segment 1). Directly inspected supplied figure: initial flat baseline labeled 1. Equipment Ch. 10 printed p. 242 Phase I explicitly describes CO2-free apparatus/anatomic dead-space gas; phase II is expiratory upstroke.

legacyReconciliation1.note: 35 vigilance and15temperature previously counted legacy verifications rechecked against actual uploaded passages. T084 downgraded for incomplete NMS comparison. No protected question field changed.

legacyReconciliation2.note: 30 circuit,15 temperature,5 respiratory legacy records independently reconciled against uploaded textbook passages. None image-dependent. No protected question field changed.

legacyReconciliation3.note: Final 27 legacy records confirmed; 20 of 23 previously unresolved circuit answers verified. B008 semiclosed gas balance, B060 anatomical generalization and B079 worldwide ranking remain unresolved. All six Mapleson image questions checked.

chapter4FiltrationPass.source: Ehrenwerth 3e, Ch4 printed pp101–106, 113–117; Ch7 printed p186
chapter4FiltrationPass.scope: Each complete keyed answer and distractor checked; source-specific stems corrected; no answer indices changed

humidificationPass.edits: Grammar and source-precision stems; B252 replaces unsupported distractor with textbook-supported intubation mechanism; no answer key or ID changes

stemAuditPass2.scope: Removed lecture/instructor attribution and corrected misleading stems; two keyed options revised (R223, R303), no answer indices changed

stemAuditPass3.source: Anesthesia Equipment 3e, Ch13 pp288–292 and Ch6 pp152,163
stemAuditPass3.summary: Replaced five unsupported or overbroad premises with textbook-supported clinical questions; revised option wording for T282 and T285; independently verified full revised answer sets.

stemAuditPass4.summary: Replaced four unsupported numeric/staged/lecture claims with directly textbook-supported metabolic, blood-loss, behavioral warming, and outcome questions; no answer-key indices changed.

ventilatorMultiPass.summary: Corrected three select-three questions to distinguish conditional expiratory-time physiology, high-PEEP consequences, and SIMV features; all revised answer sets verified.

ventilatorPrecisionPass.summary: Replaced unsupported recruitment, VCV/PCV comparative, uncuffed-ETT leak, and 2-L/min flow-trigger assertions with verified ventilator principles.

chapter19GasBalancePass.source: Anesthesia Equipment 3e Ch19 pp433,435–436,440–442 and Ch8 p213
chapter19GasBalancePass.summary: 13 complete revised answer sets verified. Corrected volume-only inference in B273 and misleading 1-MAC premise in B285; answer indices unchanged.

circuitsHumidityPrecisionPass.source: Anesthesia Equipment 3e Ch4 pp100,105–106,114–115; Ch7 pp183–185; Ch19 pp433–436,440–441
circuitsHumidityPrecisionPass.summary: 17 additional complete answer sets verified after correcting stem conditions and distractors. Clarified bag pressure limits, mid-tracheal humidification, Mapleson A/D ventilation, dry-gas hypothermia, surfactant dilution, and fresh-gas inlet location.

circuitFundamentalsPass.textbook: Ehrenwerth et al., Anesthesia Equipment, 3rd ed.
circuitFundamentalsPass.notes: Inspected actual textbook PDF printed pages. All revised stems, answer keys, and distractors checked; no keys, options, image data, IDs, ordering, or learner-history code changed.

respiratoryPrecisionPass.notes: Actual printed pages inspected; clarified detector modality, Dalton mixture, oxygen-content assumptions, physiologic capnography claim, pressure interpretation, and analyzer response. No key/option/image/ID changes.

keyCorrections.rationale: Ehrenwerth Ch. 13 p. 291 and Nurse Anesthesia Ch. 18 p. 321 explicitly define perioperative hypothermia as core temperature <36°C. Corrected key from index 1 (35°C) to index 2 (36°C).

thermoregulationPrecisionPass.evidence: Ehrenwerth Ch. 13 pp. 287–289, 291; Nurse Anesthesia Ch. 18 p. 321
thermoregulationPrecisionPass.notes: Inspected actual PDF printed pages; revised stems and explanations, checked all keyed answers and distractors. T001 key corrected from 35°C to 36°C (option index 1 to 2). No other keys or any options, images, IDs, order, difficulty or learner-history storage changed.

ventilatorSourcePrecisionPass.source: Ehrenwerth 3e Ch6 pp151, 159–160, 168; Elisha/Heiner/Nagelhout 7e Ch16 pp277–279
ventilatorSourcePrecisionPass.notes: Replaced unsupported default flow, broad BiPAP indication, automatic PaCO2 recruitment benefit, unproven absolute contraindication, recruitment-specific discomfort, and three missing pediatric table claims with directly supported concepts. Preserved original answer indices, IDs, images, ordering, difficulty and learner-history code.

equipmentSensorsCircuitsPrecisionPass.notes: Replaced unverified sidestream-prevalence claim, corrected oxygen analyzer distractors, clarified inspired CO2 causes, and removed unsupported leak-test numerical threshold. All answer indices preserved.

priorityCorrectionPass2.sources: Ehrenwerth 3e Chs. 6, 13, pp. 153, 168, 291, 295, 299; Nurse Anesthesia 7e Chs. 14, 16, 29 pp. 214, 277, 669
priorityCorrectionPass2.notes: Resolved 12 source/key/wording priority discrepancies by revising stems and distractors against inspected textbook passages; original answer indices preserved. Source-specific figures and table numbers stated precisely.

respiratoryCircuitSourcePass.notes: Resolved 32 complete answer sets by inspecting actual passages, removing lecture attributions, unsupported global ranking and fixed gas count, and qualifying gas-sampling and circuit terminology. No answer-key index or image changes.

oxygenCapnographyPrecisionPass.notes: Eight complete revised question/answer sets independently checked. Corrected unsupported historical causation, ambiguous pulmonary-perfusion options and wording; preserved all keyed indices and images.
